title: 11 Tips to Increase Your English Vocabulary
speaker: Learn English with EnglishClass101.com
zh: 【Learn English with EnglishClass101.com】增加英語詞彙量的 11 個技巧（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Want to start speaking more in your target language?
cues.en: Want to start speaking more in your target language?
cues.zh: 想要開始多用您的目標語言說話嗎？

cues.text: You'll need more words and phrases.
cues.en: You'll need more words and phrases.
cues.zh: 您將需要更多單字和短語。

cues.text: In this guide, you'll discover 11 powerful ways to learn tons of new vocabulary.
cues.en: In this guide, you'll discover 11 powerful ways to learn tons of new vocabulary.
cues.zh: 在本指南中，您將發現 11 種學習大量新詞彙的強大方法。

cues.text: Let's begin!
cues.en: Let's begin!
cues.zh: 讓我們開始吧！

cues.text: Number 1.
cues.en: Number 1.

cues.text: Sign up for the Word of the Day emails.
cues.en: Sign up for the Word of the Day emails.
cues.zh: 註冊接收每日一詞電子郵件。

cues.text: This is a completely free study tool.
cues.en: This is a completely free study tool.
cues.zh: 這是一個完全免費的學習工具。

cues.text: Just sign up and every day you'll get a brand new word delivered to your inbox.
cues.en: Just sign up and every day you'll get a brand new word delivered to your inbox.
cues.zh: 只需註冊，每天您都會收到一個全新的單字傳送到您的收件匣。

cues.text: You get the definition, the audio pronunciation, teeth, and tons of examples.
cues.en: You get the definition, the audio pronunciation, teeth, and tons of examples.
cues.zh: 您可以獲得定義、音訊發音、牙齒和大量範例。

cues.text: So you're not just learning disconnected words.
cues.en: So you're not just learning disconnected words.
cues.zh: 所以你不只是學習不連貫的單字。

cues.text: First of all, reviewing takes seconds, so this is a fast and easy way to pick up new words.
cues.en: First of all, reviewing takes seconds, so this is a fast and easy way to pick up new words.
cues.zh: 首先，複習需要幾秒鐘，所以這是一種快速、簡單的學習新單字的方法。

cues.text: So keep an eye on your email and look for our Word of the Day lessons.
cues.en: So keep an eye on your email and look for our Word of the Day lessons.
cues.zh: 因此，請留意您的電子郵件並尋找我們的每日一詞課程。

cues.text: Number 2.
cues.en: Number 2.

cues.text: Access our free vocab and phrase lists.
cues.en: Access our free vocab and phrase lists.
cues.zh: 造訪我們的免費詞彙和短語清單。

cues.text: Here you'll find tons of vocab and phrase lists based on all kinds of topics that you
cues.en: Here you'll find tons of vocab and phrase lists based on all kinds of topics that you
cues.zh: 在這裡，您將找到大量基於您所瞭解的各種主題的詞彙和短語清單。

cues.text: won't get anywhere else.
cues.en: won't get anywhere else.
cues.zh: 不會到達其他任何地方。

cues.text: Holidays, hobbies, conversational phrases, common questions, slang, and much more.
cues.en: Holidays, hobbies, conversational phrases, common questions, slang, and much more.
cues.zh: 假期、嗜好、會話短語、常見問題、俚語等等。

cues.text: You can review all of the words with the bonus audio lesson or the audio slideshow.
cues.en: You can review all of the words with the bonus audio lesson or the audio slideshow.
cues.zh: 您可以透過附贈音訊課程或音訊投影片複習所有單字。

cues.text: Number 3.
cues.en: Number 3.

cues.text: Play a lesson.
cues.en: Play a lesson.
cues.zh: 玩一堂課。

cues.text: In every lesson, you learn a conversation and then our teachers break down and translate
cues.en: In every lesson, you learn a conversation and then our teachers break down and translate
cues.zh: 在每節課中，您都會學習一段對話，然後我們的老師會分解並翻譯

cues.text: every word.
cues.en: every word.
cues.zh: 每一個字。

cues.text: So here, you're actually learning words in the context of conversations and you can easily
cues.en: So here, you're actually learning words in the context of conversations and you can easily
cues.zh: 所以在這裡，你實際上是在對話的背景下學習單詞，你可以很容易地

cues.text: see how they're used.
cues.en: see how they're used.
cues.zh: 看看它們是如何使用的。

cues.text: Number 4.
cues.en: Number 4.

cues.text: Review the Lesson Vocabulary section.
cues.en: Review the Lesson Vocabulary section.
cues.zh: 複習課程詞彙部分。

cues.text: Want to master the key vocabulary from a lesson?
cues.en: Want to master the key vocabulary from a lesson?
cues.zh: 想掌握課程中的關鍵字彙嗎？

cues.text: Use the vocabulary section of any lesson.
cues.en: Use the vocabulary section of any lesson.
cues.zh: 使用任何課程的詞彙部分。

cues.text: Here you can review the translations and the audio pronunciations of each word.
cues.en: Here you can review the translations and the audio pronunciations of each word.
cues.zh: 在這裡您可以檢視每個單字的翻譯和音訊發音。

cues.text: You can even play slowed down pronunciations to fully grasp each word.
cues.en: You can even play slowed down pronunciations to fully grasp each word.
cues.zh: 您甚至可以放慢發音以完全掌握每個單字。

cues.text: Number 5.
cues.en: Number 5.

cues.text: Play the Audio Slideshow.
cues.en: Play the Audio Slideshow.
cues.zh: 播放音訊幻燈片。

cues.text: Want to play words on a loop until they're stuck in your head?
cues.en: Want to play words on a loop until they're stuck in your head?
cues.zh: 想要迴圈播放單字直到它們牢牢印在您的腦海中嗎？

cues.text: You can do this with the Audio Slideshow.
cues.en: You can do this with the Audio Slideshow.
cues.zh: 您可以使用音訊幻燈片來做到這一點。

cues.text: This feature is available on every free vocab list and on all of the lessons.
cues.en: This feature is available on every free vocab list and on all of the lessons.
cues.zh: 每個免費詞彙表和所有課程都提供此功能。

cues.text: With the lessons, just scroll down to the vocab section and click on Slideshow.
cues.en: With the lessons, just scroll down to the vocab section and click on Slideshow.
cues.zh: 對於課程，只需向下捲動到詞彙部分並點選幻燈片即可。

cues.text: Number 6.
cues.en: Number 6.

cues.text: Review the Lesson Notes.
cues.en: Review the Lesson Notes.
cues.zh: 複習課程筆記。

cues.text: You get in-depth lesson notes for every lesson, including grammar explanations, plus extra
cues.en: You get in-depth lesson notes for every lesson, including grammar explanations, plus extra
cues.zh: 您將獲得每節課的深入課程筆記，包括文法解釋以及額外的內容

cues.text: vocab and sample sentences not mentioned in the lesson.
cues.en: vocab and sample sentences not mentioned in the lesson.
cues.zh: 課程中未提及的詞彙和例句。

cues.text: You can even download the notes as PDFs to print or keep for yourself.
cues.en: You can even download the notes as PDFs to print or keep for yourself.
cues.zh: 您甚至可以將筆記下載為 PDF 格式，以便列印或自行儲存。

cues.text: Number 7.
cues.en: Number 7.

cues.text: Get the 2000 Most Common Words List.
cues.en: Get the 2000 Most Common Words List.
cues.zh: 取得 2000 個最常用單字清單。

cues.text: Language experts say you need around 1500 words to be conversationally fluent.
cues.en: Language experts say you need around 1500 words to be conversationally fluent.
cues.zh: 語言專家表示，您需要大約 1500 個單字才能進行流利的對話。

cues.text: Here you get 2000 must-know words sorted into categories such as verbs, adjectives, and everyday
cues.en: Here you get 2000 must-know words sorted into categories such as verbs, adjectives, and everyday
cues.zh: 這裡有 2000 個必須知道的單詞，依動詞、形容詞和日常等類別分類

cues.text: words, even numbers.
cues.en: words, even numbers.
cues.zh: 單字，偶數。

cues.text: You'll see the top 100 words, the top 200, 300, up to 2000.
cues.en: You'll see the top 100 words, the top 200, 300, up to 2000.
cues.zh: 您將看到前 100 個單字、前 200 個、前 300 個、最多 2000 個單字。

cues.text: You can study these words with the slideshow or send them to the word bank or flashcards.
cues.en: You can study these words with the slideshow or send them to the word bank or flashcards.
cues.zh: 您可以透過幻燈片學習這些單字或將它們傳送到單字型檔或抽認卡。

cues.text: Number 8.
cues.en: Number 8.

cues.text: Word Bank.
cues.en: Word Bank.
cues.zh: 詞庫。

cues.text: The word bank is your personal database of words and phrases.
cues.en: The word bank is your personal database of words and phrases.
cues.zh: 單字型檔是您的個人單字和短語資料庫。

cues.text: If you come across a word you like and want to review later, save it to your word bank.
cues.en: If you come across a word you like and want to review later, save it to your word bank.
cues.zh: 如果您遇到喜歡的單字並想稍後複習，請將其儲存到單字型檔中。

cues.text: You can save words and phrases from lessons, free vocab lists, and the core 2000 word list.
cues.en: You can save words and phrases from lessons, free vocab lists, and the core 2000 word list.
cues.zh: 您可以儲存課程中的單字和短語、免費詞彙清單和核心 2000 個單字清單。

cues.text: With the word bank, you can even create and print out word lists to use as physical
cues.en: With the word bank, you can even create and print out word lists to use as physical
cues.zh: 使用單字型檔，您甚至可以建立並列印單字清單以用作物理

cues.text: study material.
cues.en: study material.
cues.zh: 學習材料。

cues.text: Number 9.
cues.en: Number 9.

cues.text: Remember words forever with spaced repetition flashcards.
cues.en: Remember words forever with spaced repetition flashcards.
cues.zh: 使用間隔重複抽認卡永遠記住單字。

cues.text: Spaced repetition flashcards are a powerful language learning tool.
cues.en: Spaced repetition flashcards are a powerful language learning tool.
cues.zh: 間隔重複抽認卡是強大的語言學習工具。

cues.text: They track your progress, they show you words based on how well you know them, and show
cues.en: They track your progress, they show you words based on how well you know them, and show
cues.zh: 他們追蹤您的進度，根據您對單字的瞭解程度向您展示單詞，並顯示

cues.text: them to you again at the right times so you don't forget them.
cues.en: them to you again at the right times so you don't forget them.
cues.zh: 在正確的時間再次向您傳送，這樣您就不會忘記它們。

cues.text: So if you get a word right, you'll see it again in 7 days, then in 14, then every
cues.en: So if you get a word right, you'll see it again in 7 days, then in 14, then every
cues.zh: 因此，如果你答對了一個詞，你會在 7 天后再次看到它，然後在 14 天后，然後每隔一天

cues.text: once in a while just to refresh your memory.
cues.en: once in a while just to refresh your memory.
cues.zh: 偶爾只是為了重新整理你的記憶。

cues.text: If you get it wrong, you'll see it again and again until you get it right.
cues.en: If you get it wrong, you'll see it again and again until you get it right.
cues.zh: 如果你做錯了，你會一遍又一遍地看到它，直到你做對為止。

cues.text: You can create flashcard decks from any lesson vocab section, word bank entry, the top 2000
cues.en: You can create flashcard decks from any lesson vocab section, word bank entry, the top 2000
cues.zh: 您可以從任何課程詞彙部分、單字型檔條目、前 2000 個詞彙建立抽認卡組

cues.text: core word list, and the free vocab and phrase lists.
cues.en: core word list, and the free vocab and phrase lists.
cues.zh: 核心單字清單以及免費詞彙和短語清單。

cues.text: Number 10.
cues.en: Number 10.

cues.text: Use the audio dictionary.
cues.en: Use the audio dictionary.
cues.zh: 使用音訊詞典。

cues.text: If you want to look up a word, you can easily use our free dictionary.
cues.en: If you want to look up a word, you can easily use our free dictionary.
cues.zh: 如果您想查詢單詞，您可以輕鬆使用我們的免費字典。

cues.text: And you can save these words into your word bank as well.
cues.en: And you can save these words into your word bank as well.
cues.zh: 您也可以將這些單字儲存到您的單字型檔中。

cues.text: Number 11.
cues.en: Number 11.

cues.text: Get even more lessons in the lesson library.
cues.en: Get even more lessons in the lesson library.
cues.zh: 在課程庫中取得更多課程。

cues.text: If you want even more vocab lessons, then visit our lesson library, and under category,
cues.en: If you want even more vocab lessons, then visit our lesson library, and under category,
cues.zh: 如果您想要更多詞彙課程，請訪問我們的課程庫，並在類別下，

cues.text: choose vocabulary.
cues.en: choose vocabulary.
cues.zh: 選擇詞彙。

cues.text: You'll get all of the lessons dedicated to helping you master must know vocabulary.
cues.en: You'll get all of the lessons dedicated to helping you master must know vocabulary.
cues.zh: 您將獲得專門幫助您掌握必須瞭解的詞彙的所有課程。

cues.text: So if you're ready to finally learn language the fast, fun, and easy way, and if you want
cues.en: So if you're ready to finally learn language the fast, fun, and easy way, and if you want
cues.zh: 因此，如果您最終準備好以快速、有趣且簡單的方式學習語言，並且如果您願意

cues.text: to start speaking from your very first lesson, get our complete learning program.
cues.en: to start speaking from your very first lesson, get our complete learning program.
cues.zh: 要從第一堂課開始講話，請獲取我們完整的學習計劃。

cues.text: Sign up for your free lifetime account right now.
cues.en: Sign up for your free lifetime account right now.
cues.zh: 立即註冊您的免費終身帳戶。

cues.text: Click the link in the description.
cues.en: Click the link in the description.
cues.zh: 按一下說明中的連結。

cues.text: And if you enjoyed these tips, hit the like button, share it with anyone who's trying
cues.en: And if you enjoyed these tips, hit the like button, share it with anyone who's trying
cues.zh: 如果您喜歡這些技巧，請點選「讚」按鈕，與任何正在嘗試的人分享

cues.text: to learn a language, and subscribe to our channel.
cues.en: to learn a language, and subscribe to our channel.
cues.zh: 學習語言並訂閱我們的頻道。

cues.text: We release new videos every week.
cues.en: We release new videos every week.
cues.zh: 我們每週都會發布新影片。

cues.text: I'll see you next time.
cues.en: I'll see you next time.
cues.zh: 下次見。
